question: Baishagu festival is associated with the state of _____ in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Baishagu

 
 
• ​This is a new year festival celebrated every year by the Bodo Kacharis in the month of Baisakh (mid-April).
 
• The festival begins with the worship of cows on the first day and continues with the worship of their supreme God, Bathou (identified with Lord Shiva).
 
• Community feast and dancing on the second day before it is concluded with a prayer at a designated place called girjasali.
